description: Retrieve POWER's ASHRAE-style climatic design conditions for one latitude/longitude: 87 scalar indicators (heating and humidification, cooling, dehumidification and enthalpy, extreme annual and annual summaries) and 38 twelve-month arrays, January first, each with its POWER code, report section, label and units. NASA computes them for the requested point over whole calendar years; prefer them to rebuilding design percentiles from hourly nasa_power_get_timeseries data. Supply startYear and endYear together, or omit both for POWER's full configured coverage; a window outside that coverage or shorter than its minimum span is refused with the range in force, and request echoes the years sent. Values are metric only; fill values and absent months are null.

endYear.description: Last calendar year of the period, inclusive; supply with startYear, or omit both for the full configured coverage

startYear.description: First calendar year of the period; supply with endYear, or omit both for the full configured coverage

name: nasa_power_get_design_conditions

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_window`: Years are unpaired, reversed, outside the configured coverage or span less than its minimum. `upstream_rejected`: NASA rejects the design-conditions request. `upstream_rate_limited`: NASA responds with a rate limit. `request_queue_full`: Source scheduling capacity is exhausted. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.
